modules.name: Sway
modules.description: Polyphonic LFO with morphing shapes, random, end-of-cycle trigger, clock sync, phase spread and one-shot mode

modules.name: Fathom
modules.description: Deep bass drone voice: sub sine, 7-saw supersaw, drift, low-pass

modules.name: Shoal
modules.description: The Ornament & Crime v1.3.6 firmware (Patrick Dowling, Max Stadler, Tim Churches) running on emulated hardware

modules.name: Sluice
modules.description: Quad VCA: four DC-coupled polyphonic VCAs, CV added to level, inputs normalled down, outputs mixed down, linear or exponential

modules.name: Fog
modules.description: Stereo reverb for enormous, dark, slowly blooming spaces: time-based decay, bloom, drift, four modes

modules.name: Hadal
modules.description: Rumble and noise: a bed of sub rumble, hiss and crackle that Depth darkens and Drift moves, with an output per layer
modules.keywords: noise rumble hiss crackle ambient drone bed texture

modules.name: Ballast
modules.description: Four-channel stereo mixer: Level and a VCA level CV per channel, Master with CV, chain inputs, DC-blocked soft-limited out, expander-ready

modules.name: Pan
modules.description: Pan expander for Ballast: pan, CV and attenuverter per channel; true stereo pan or balance
modules.keywords: pan panning stereo balance ballast expander

modules.name: Squall
modules.description: Random gates and CV: Weather sets how much happens, Gust bunches it into bursts, Memory replays the recent past; free-running or clocked
modules.keywords: random gates cv weather gust memory loop sample hold drift ambient

modules.name: Rigging
modules.description: Six tuned strings: a drone from any sound, or struck by a trigger or a new note; seven chords, a level per string, Ring to 60 s, Damp, Spread, CV on Chord, Ring and Damp
modules.keywords: strings resonator karplus strong pluck strum drone chord comb ambient

modules.name: Wake
modules.description: Stereo echo, 10 ms to 10 s: Tape, Analog and Digital styles, a Ratio between the sides, ping pong, Freeze, Diffuse, Drift, a clock input, CV on Time, Feedback and Mix
modules.keywords: delay echo tape analog bbd digital ping pong freeze diffuse stereo ambient

modules.name: Narrows
modules.description: Polyphonic stereo filter: low-pass, band-pass and high-pass on a smooth Mode sweep, a ladder and a state-variable core on a switch, drive, resonance to self-oscillation in tune, a comb tuned to the cutoff, a Ping input and Spread
modules.keywords: filter vcf ladder moog state variable svf lowpass bandpass highpass comb ping resonator stereo polyphonic

modules.name: Eddy
modules.description: Stereo tape loop and sampler: record up to 5 minutes or load a WAV, speed from twice forwards through stopped to twice backwards, a window by Start and Length, Dub, Wear, Smear at the join, Restore to the original, kept with the patch
modules.keywords: tape loop looper sampler sound on sound dub wear varispeed reverse wav ambient

modules.name: Spindrift
modules.description: Mutable Instruments Beads, its own code in the Instrument look: a granular cloud, delay mode, four qualities, Beads' reverb and wavetable synth, and a window on the grains; the frozen buffer kept with the patch
modules.keywords: granular grains cloud beads mutable instruments clouds freeze delay reverb wavetable texture ambient

modules.name: Beacon
modules.description: Polyphonic envelope: Gate, Trig and Hold (a slew limiter) on a switch, Attack, Decay and Release from 1 ms to 60 s with CV, Shape from reverse through linear to classic, a gate per stage, a stage trigger, OUT and INV, and a window that draws the envelope
modules.keywords: envelope adsr ar ad eg contour gate trigger retrigger slew lag portamento polyphonic

modules.name: Neap
modules.description: Eight slow cycles at their own rates: eight outputs, a weighted TIDE sum and a HIGH gate, Drift, Weight, Mark and Reset, with Spring as its expander
modules.keywords: lfo slow tide eight cycles polyrhythm random drift modulation

modules.name: Spring
modules.description: Neap's expander: folds, min and max, triggers and step codes from the eight cycles
modules.keywords: neap expander fold min max trigger steps quantiser

modules.name: Doldrums
modules.description: Freeze and stretch: holds a moment or draws the last 30 seconds out, with a tuned comb, a tape window and a gate for recording a pass
modules.keywords: freeze stretch paulstretch spectral drone ambient comb hold
